monument_name: Nhū Bāhāḥ at Dhalāyacā (16th cent. CE)
description_en: Nhū Bahāḥ belongs to the 12 branch offices of Bū Bāhāḥ. Nhū Bāhāḥis accessible from the main street through a portico which has been encroached upon from the west so that it is now just half its original size. The three-story monastic building with the main shrine (kvāḥpāḥ chẽ) is part of the south wing of the courtyard. It can be entered through a carved wooden door that is flanked by two small lattice windows. An alternate entrance is from from the courtyard behind the monastic building. The first floor shrine houses a statue of Akṣobhya Buddha facing north.The monastic building is covered with zinc sheets. One of six plain struts (ṭuḍāla) supporting the roof is missing. In the center of the first floor one can find an elongated window with five openings (pasukā jhyā) and two smaller windows on either side. The facdeis decorated with a timber cornice that include bands of traditional motifs such asnāgo,chuvā,dhalimvaḥandkhicāvā. There are two aedicules on either side between the lintel and sill ends. Their presence is further emphasised by smaller aedicules on either sides. The brick masonry is of poor quality and the cornice bricks are not well placed.The plinth edges are original but the pavement is new.According toLocke(1985, 122) the entrance to this shrine used to be guarded by two stone lions and surmounted by atoraṇadepicting the Akṣobhya Buddha. However, both the stone lions and thetoraṇahave disappeared. On the left-hand side, just inside the main door, is a small image of Gaṇeśa.At the centre of the courtyard is avajradhātu caitya. South of the bāhāḥ is another courtyard with asikharakūṭoparipadma caityaanda Nārāyaṇa temple.According toLocke(1985, 162), there used to be a badly damaged inscription of King Jayaratna Malla dated NS 639.
description_ne: यो विहार धलायचा टोलमा रहेको छ । पेटेक (१९८४ : ११२) ले पाटनका राजा जयसिंह मल्ल यस विहारमा बसेका थिए भन्ने जानकारी दिएका छन् ।विहारको बाहिरी प्रवेशद्वार विहारको पश्चिमी भागमा रहेको छ । लक (१९८५ : १२२) ले विहारको बहिरी प्रवेशद्वारको दायाँबायाँ सिंहका मूर्ति र द्वारको माथि अक्षोभ्य बुद्धको प्रतिमा भएको तोरण रहेको कुरा बताएका छन्, तर अहिले त्यहाँ सिंहका मूर्ति पनि छैनन् र तोरण पनि छैन । प्रवेशद्वारको भित्रपट्टि बायाँ तर्फ गणेशको सानो मूर्ति छ । प्रवेशद्वारको सिधा अगाडि बाहाको क्वाः पाः छेँ रहेको छ । क्वाः पाः छेँ को माथि रहेको बाहाको छानो जस्ता पाताले छाइएको छ । बाहाको छानामा गजूर छैन र छाना पाँच वटा सादा टुँडालद्वारा थमाइएको छ । त्यहाँको खालि ठाउँबाट एउटा टुँडाल हराएको स्पस्ट देखिन्छ । बाहाको पहिलो तलाको अगाडिको भागमा पासुका झ्याल छ र झ्यालको दायाँबायाँ साना झ्याल रहेका छन् । बाहाको गर्भगृहमा अक्षोभ्य बुद्धको उत्तराभिमुख मूर्ति छ । सामान्य रूपमा अन्य बाहामा प्रवेशद्वारको दायाँबायाँ सिंहका मूर्ति राखिएको भेटिन्छ, तर यस बाहामा त्यो देखिँदैन । बाहाको आँगनमा एउटा वज्रधातु चैत्य छ । बाहाको पछाडि दक्षिणतर्फ एउटा ननि छ जहाँ एउटा शिखरोपरिपद्म चैत्य, नारायण मन्दिर र एउटा इनार रहेको छ ।लक (१९८५ : १६२) ले दिएको जानकारी अनुसार राजा जयरत्न मल्लको पालाको नेसं ६३९ को एउटा शिलालेख विहार परिसरमा थियो,तर त्यो शिलालेख हाल त्यहाँ उपलब्ध छैन ।
monument_assessment: Rebuilt, Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
references: Sources and references Sources Vaidya & Śākya 1970, 153; Pruscha (1975: 152) has misread the date as 1462 (NS 582) The inscription is lost.
